detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps in Open-Ended Learning
detail.summary: Autonomous systems identify research gaps by integrating intrinsic motivation metrics with goal-based open-ended learning frameworks, allowing agents to self-generate tasks and explore unstructured problem spaces.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook to integrate evidence from the GOAL-Robots project regarding self-generated goals and open-ended learning.
